name: Chuul

source.note: The 2024 Chuul (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). Paralyzing Tentacles' Poisoned-and-Paralyzed pairing is entered as Poisoned with Paralyzed as its linked condition.

languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The chuul can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.summary: Senses magic within 120 ft, like Detect Magic but not itself magical.
traits.text: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but is not itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Pincer attacks and Paralyzing Tentacles.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.summary: Reach 10 ft. A Large or smaller target is Grappled in one of two pincers (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
actions.summary: DC 13 Con save by a creature it holds, or Poisoned and Paralyzed (saves each turn, up to a minute).
actions.text: Constitution saving throw, DC 13, one creature Grappled by the chuul. Failure: Poisoned, with a repeat save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, and an automatic success after 1 minute. While Poisoned this way the target is also Paralyzed.

summary: A crustacean horror: crushing pincers seize prey and its tentacles paralyze whoever it holds.
